scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/kernel && npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/core-pack && npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/sdk && npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/trinacria-ui && npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/admin-kernel
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/playground && npm run build -w @trinacria-cms/backoffice
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && (npm run dev:playground:watch & npm run dev:backoffice:watch & wait)
scripts.dev:playground: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:playground:watch
scripts.dev:backoffice: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:backoffice:watch
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: node --import tsx --test test/**/*.integration.test.ts && npm run test:integration -w @trinacria-cms/kernel
